subject: Step: Deliver
description:
Review the branch against the task with git log and git diff against the base. If anything blocks, put every blocker in one ask_the_person question and stop.
Leave the branch landable: git status is empty, nothing the repository ignores is committed, noise commits such as wip or fix typo are squashed, and messages say why.
Report the branch, what is on it, and what the person needs before merging: a follow-up not done, a decision they might reverse, a check that is green only because something unrelated was fixed.
Delivery in this Job: the branch is already pushed. Ask the person to merge it into the main line with ask_the_person, and stop until it is merged. Fleet ticks the last gate when it sees the merge on origin. Then say what landed and call all_done.
